theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_dr_withDensity_carrier_of_absolutelyContinuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (M₀ : Set (Euclid P)), μ univ < ∞ → MeasurableSet M₀ → ν M₀ < ∞ → μ M₀ᶜ = 0 → (∀ E : Set (Euclid P), ν E = 0 → μ E = 0) → ∃ (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet M ∧ M ⊆ M₀ ∧ Measurable θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) ∧ μ = (ν.restrict M).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
